{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out internal test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders)
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
